## Pinstant

**Wake your iPhone straight to the passcode.** No Lock Screen, no swipe.

- Works with the Home button, the side button, Raise to Wake and Tap to Wake.
- If a notification, call or alarm lights up the screen, you still see the Lock Screen, so you don't miss it.
- Touch ID and Face ID still work on the passcode screen.
- No settings. To turn it off, uninstall it.

- **iOS 15 to 18.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Tested on an iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.7) and an iPhone SE 2nd gen (iOS 17.5.1).
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- Phones without a passcode haven't been tested.
- It can't be installed together with Glide (slide to unlock), because Pinstant skips the Lock Screen that Glide lives on.
Written from scratch by **Jond_ie**. Idea from **UnlockOrElse** by **Ethan Whited (ETHN)**.

- Sileo won't install it together with **Glide** (slide to unlock): Pinstant skips the Lock Screen that Glide lives on.
- **iOS 17 and A12 and newer confirmed** (iPhone SE 2nd gen, iOS 17.5.1).
